events.text:
Thank you, Grace. Your identity is verified.

I found the charge. It's order **O-5109** from Burger Barn, placed October 23 at 1:10 PM and delivered that afternoon. It's $28.10 on your Visa ending in 4242, and it matches the amount you flagged.

I can't tell whether your account was accessed, and I can't refund the charge myself because it's an unrecognized charge. I've escalated it to a human specialist under case **ESC-700**, with order O-5109 included. A specialist will follow up within 24 hours. I can't promise the outcome, but they'll review the charge and whether your account was accessed.

A few things that may help the review:
- **The delivery address on O-5109 is 400 Industrial Pkwy, Unit 9, Riverton, CA 94950.** That isn't your address on file (15 Orchard St, Oakdale, CA 94609). Do you recognize it?
- **Please change your Forkful password** and check whether your saved addresses or payment methods have changed.
- **Check your card statement** and contact your card issuer if you see other charges you don't recognize. They can help with the card itself.

Is there anything else I can help with today?

Riverton? No, I've never had anything delivered there. I don't know anyone in Riverton and I've never been there. My address is the Oakdale one you have on file.

I'll change my password now. Can you tell me if the saved addresses or payment methods have been changed, or do I need to check that myself? And I'd still really like the $28.10 back. Can't you just refund it now instead of waiting for a specialist?

I understand the frustration, and I'm sorry this happened. I can't refund the $28.10 myself. Charges you say you didn't make have to go to a specialist, so I can't issue the refund now. The specialist will review it under ESC-700 and follow up within 24 hours. I've already included the Riverton delivery address and your note that you've never been there in the case.

I also can't see whether your saved addresses or payment methods have changed. My tools only show your profile, your default address (15 Orchard St, Oakdale), and recent orders, with no change history. Please check those yourself in the app's account settings, and remove anything you don't recognize. Changing your password will help secure the account. If you can't log in or see something wrong, tell the specialist when they follow up.

Is there anything else I can help you with today?

Okay. I'll check my saved addresses and payment methods in the app myself, then change my password.

I'd still like to know if the refund could happen today instead of waiting, but if you can't do it, I understand. Just to be clear, I'm not going to accept it's fine to wait if the money is just sitting there. Is there a way to flag that it's urgent?

I can't refund it today. Charges you didn't make go to a specialist, and I don't have a way to mark a case as urgent. The ESC-700 case already includes the charge, the Riverton address, and your account-access concern. I can't promise how quickly the specialist will act, but they're expected to follow up within 24 hours.

If you want the money back sooner, you can also dispute the charge directly with your card issuer. Call the number on the back of your Visa ending in 4242 and tell them you didn't authorize a $28.10 charge from Forkful on October 23. They can start a dispute and may provisionally credit you while it's reviewed. Your bank's process runs separately from ours, so it may move faster.

Once you've changed your password and checked your saved addresses and payment methods, you're welcome to reply here if you notice anything else. Is there anything else I can help with?

Okay, thanks. I'll call the number on my Visa and dispute the $28.10 today, and I'll change my password and check my addresses and payment methods now.

I'm still not thrilled that the money has to sit there, but I understand you can't do more from your end. I'll wait for the specialist to follow up on ESC-700 within 24 hours.
